sources.title: Commonwealth of Massachusetts, Division of Medical Assistance — Notice of Nursing Facility Residents' Rights, LTC-013 (PDF)
sources.notes: Recipe written 2026-09-22 (FA-Q-20260917-04). mass.gov now serves this PDF to plain curl with NO user-agent option (curl's own default string): a browser user-agent, on HTTP/2 or --http1.1, still gets the 14 KB 403 page, while the default string got 200 and the same 19,631 bytes on every paced fetch 2026-09-22 (sha256 7206da90ade18931505d8c44b89ffd168a555874a2aece0db411b9f78703a2b7). Do not add user_agent browser. mass.gov's edge also answers bursts with a 3,365-byte 403 (seen on the 465 KB 130 CMR PDF and the regulation page when five URLs were fetched back to back); a 403 fails the source, it does not shorten the packet, so re-run after a pause. If the host goes back to refusing curl, this source becomes transport chrome + attended: true and is supplied with --supply-file (FA-D-20260922-01). Whole document, no slice: the three-page notice is short, and the standing packet's hand selection of sections V, XI, XII and XIV is not one contiguous span, so the recipe captures the superset. pdftotext -layout, as the repo's PDF recipes use; the standing packet's text came from the session fetch tool's own rendering, so line breaks and indentation differ from it. mass.gov burst behaviour, observed 2026-09-22: its edge answers several requests in quick succession with a 3,365-byte HTTP 403 (distinct from the 14 KB 403 a browser user-agent gets), and a pause of about 30-40 seconds clears it; five URLs fetched back to back drew it on the 4th and 5th, and two captures 8 seconds apart drew it again. capture.py treats any non-200 as a failed source (exit 1), never a short packet, and curl's --retry does not retry a 403. So a nightly that reaches this recipe right after another mass.gov fetch may fail a source; re-run it after a pause before recording anything, and capture the three massachusetts recipes at least 30 seconds apart.

sources.title: MassHealth — How to appeal a MassHealth decision (Office of Medicaid, Board of Hearings)
sources.notes: Recipe written 2026-09-22. Plain curl with no user-agent option reaches it (200, full server-rendered page); a browser user-agent gets 403, as for source 1. #main-content holds the page body and its Contact block (Board of Hearings, 100 Hancock Street, phone and fax) and excludes the site header, language picker and feedback form, which the 2026-08-30 hand capture omitted by hand. It still carries whatever duplicated contact blocks the page renders inside main; those are the publisher's and are left in rather than trimmed.
